name: Elise
notes: Elise opens in Human Form: Neurotoxin (Q) is cast first while the dummy is at full health (Neurotoxin scales off current health, so it is strongest immediately), then Volatile Spiderling (W) once, then she permanently switches to Spider Form and never returns to Human Form for the rest of the fight, per the dossier's proposed rotation.

In Spider Form, Venomous Bite (Q) and Skittering Frenzy (W) are recast on cooldown; Skittering Frenzy grants Elise bonus attack speed for 3 s and resets her attack timer, and its own cooldown (6 s, EliseSpiderW) is shorter than Human Form's Volatile Spiderling cooldown (12 s, EliseHumanW) used for the opener.

Spider Queen's bonus on-hit magic damage (Spider Form only) is dealt as separate proc damage on every basic attack while in Spider Form; its self-heal is ignored since healing does not matter in this fight.

Neurotoxin scales off the target's current health and Venomous Bite off the target's missing health, both plus 3% per 100 AP; since the caster's AP is fixed for a given item build, the ratio (base% + 0.03*AP) is computed once at setup as a percent and applied to the target's live current/missing health at each cast by dividing by 100.

Elise's Spiderling swarm (their own basic attacks, spawn timing beyond the passive on-hit bonus) is not modeled: the sheet/wiki give no base attack speed, range or attack cadence for Spiderlings (deferred to a separate Pets page), so only Elise's own Q/W/on-hit damage is simulated, per the dossier's offered option to treat pet damage as out of scope.

Cocoon and Rappel (E) are never cast: Cocoon deals no damage, and Rappel is a defensive/mobility tool whose 5 s Spider Queen damage-amp formula is unresolved in the sheet; the stationary, non-attacking dummy gains nothing from either.

Volatile Spiderling's explosion is treated as landing on cast, after the standard 0.25 s cast lockout, since its exact travel/detonation delay against an adjacent stationary target is not given precisely by the sources.
If Spider Form (R) is not yet learned (pre-level 6), Elise stays in Human Form the whole fight and simply recasts Volatile Spiderling on its own 12 s cooldown instead of transforming.
Mana costs are not modeled: at level 16 none of Elise's costs would realistically stall this rotation within a 15 s fight.
